cv_telemetry_dog.findings: high dose only: transient ↑ heart rate (+18%) 2-4h post-dose, no QT prolongation (QTc within historical control)
cv_telemetry_dog.herg_followup: patch-clamp confirmed cellular hERG IC50 = 18.4 µM, 23-fold over Cmax,unbound at MRSD

cns_irwin_rat.findings: 150 mg/kg only: decreased locomotor activity 1-3h post-dose

respiratory_plethysmography_rat.findings: no effect on respiratory rate, tidal volume, or minute volume at any dose

overall_safety_pharm_conclusion: No adverse cardiovascular, CNS, or respiratory effects at clinically relevant exposures. hERG margin (cellular IC50 / unbound Cmax at MRSD) ≥ 20× supports cardiac safety.
